amendment_reason: Owner clarified Blender-Lab as an open accessible computational research instrument and Neuro3D as its optical-neural demonstrator, independently of fabricating a photonic processor.
research_question: Can Blender-Lab construct and execute coherent optical neural networks from the actual Blender scene with quantitatively valid, reproducible results, useful error certificates and explicit rejection beyond its model?
instrument_goal: Open accessible Blender research environment with editable scenes, quantitative optical solver, neural demonstrator, independent validation and reproducible experiment export.
H1: Every CERTIFIED complex field enclosure includes exact truth for the admitted represented scalar model; paths are complete or omitted contributions rigorously bounded; intensity and decisions follow the enclosure.
H1_refutation: One independently verified false enclosure, invalid certified decision, or unbounded lost nonzero relevant path.
nonvacuity: All complete members of a prospectively fixed useful family must be certified; universal rejection does not support utility.
instrument_acceptance_axes: open distributable dependencies and CPU starter examples
initial_implementation_design: Packaged Blender extension plus modular scientific solver, reference CPU, native GPU adapters and reproducible scenes.
initial_physical_model: ideal scalar coherent optics in a declared ray regime
